operation.summary: Track a person's body for up to 2 minutes: the phone finds 33 body points in every camera frame (ML Kit, offline and free; no picture leaves the phone). Read the frames as they come with GET /v1/camera/pose/{id}

body.name: camera
body.description: front (default, the person can see the screen) or rear

body.name: seconds
body.description: How long to track, 5-120 (default 60). It also stops when nobody has read it for 10 s

body.name: preview_every_ms
body.description: How often to refresh the small preview picture, 150-2000 (default 400)

body.name: preview_edge_px
body.description: Longest side of the preview picture, 120-480 (default 320)

operation.returns: session_id, state starting|running, camera, mirror (true for front: draw it mirrored), max_ms, started_at

seconds.description: How long to track, 5-120 (default 60). It also stops when nobody has read it for 10 s

preview_edge_px.description: Longest side of the preview picture, 120-480 (default 320)
